title: narcissus × biflorus var. sterilis
intro: Narcissus × biflorus var. sterilis, commonly known as the sterile narcissus or poison lily, is a rare and toxic variant of the narcissus plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × biflorus var. sterils include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which may help alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which have been studied for their potential neuroprotective and antimicrobial properties.
